pretreatments.description: Mechanical degradation of A. tequilana bagasse using a blade mill to reduce fibers to an average length of 0.5 cm.
Chemical pretreatment using dilute acid catalysts, specifically hydrochloric acid (HCl) or sulfuric acid (H2SO4), at concentrations varied according to a central composite design (CCD).

Thermal treatment where A. tequilana bagasse dispersed in acid solutions was introduced in an oven for periods of time and temperatures varied according to a central composite design (CCD), reaching up to 157 °C.
